session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend From The Open, Midday Reversal Down'. Bull trend off the higher-low double bottom at the open (4145) into the 4162 wedge top, a higher-low major trend reversal pullback to 4152, a second bull wedge to the 4171 expanding triangle top, then a midday reversal down with sell the close, an ii final flag and outside-outside at the 4138 lows, and a late profit-taking rally to the 4154 midpoint.
